name: bolster-ranks-class-bonus-costs-two-summons-buffed-drone
notes: Bolster Ranks (n0esog2898, NEOS/GUARDIAN ACTION, printed reserve 3): "[Class Bonus] This card costs 1 less to activate. Choose one -- Summon an Automaton Drone token with a buff counter on it; or put a buff counter on each ally you control." Same double-Class-Bonus-discount engine bug as Shifting Mirage (generated activationCostModifierAbilities['n0esog2898:0'] AND the ClassBonusActivateCostReduction() table both applied the discount, so it cost 1 instead of 2). The champion is patched to Tonoris, Creation's Will (NEOS + GUARDIAN, Tonoris lineage) so the NEOS element and the Class Bonus are active. The card is played for real and needs exactly TWO reserve payments (unresolved after one, resolved after two); the YES mode then summons an Automaton Drone with exactly one buff counter. The final NO declines Tonoris, Creation's Will's own optional Drone-replacement prompt.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] This card costs 1 less to activate.
Choose one - Summon an Automaton Drone token with a buff counter on it.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Bolster Ranks' printed '[Class Bonus] This card costs 1 less to activate' was applied TWICE: once by the generated activationCostModifierAbilities['n0esog2898:0'] (via ApplyGeneratedReserveLikeCostModifiers) and once more by the hand-maintained ClassBonusActivateCostReduction() table in Custom/GameLogic.php (which still listed n0esog2898). With the Class Bonus active, printed reserve 3 became 1 instead of 2 (same defect first confirmed live on Shifting Mirage; swept from the table: this card measured with=1 expected 2). Fix: the three cards that already carry a generated '[Class Bonus] -1' activation modifier (hmjr33ijq6 Shifting Mirage, n0esog2898 Bolster Ranks, gn1b2sbrq9 Echoic Guard) were removed from the ClassBonusActivateCostReduction() table so the generated modifier is the single source of the discount; the exact cost (2 with the Class Bonus, 3 without) is now pinned. A sweep of all 65 table entries found no other card double-discounted (Galestream Insight usa6qyq3ka correctly keeps its table entry because its generated modifier is only the separate [Memory 4+] discount).
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php ClassBonusActivateCostReduction() table (entries for hmjr33ijq6, n0esog2898, gn1b2sbrq9 removed) consumed by CalculateActivationReserveCost()
